objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level within the document pyramid indicating the strategic or operational scope.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: A type-based abbreviation prefix combined with a consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, incremented upon revisions or changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable time span (default 3 years) after which validity must be reviewed.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The configurable time span (default 10 years) for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The area or areas of validity for which the document applies.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content, supporting multi-language versions.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person registered as the primary author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with write permissions on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to review the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) authorized to approve and release the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution upon release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release process statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing document, created by authors without affecting the document's current content or version history, managed within the document's cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a document and initiate the archiving process, processed through a workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group and processed through a workflow.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user determining their permissions and functions (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign authorizations, reader access, and distribution list membership for documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the approval and release steps for documents, including creator, review, and release stages.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company that can be linked to documents and processes.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing of documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents within the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data objects (e.g. IT applications) that can be linked to documents for cross-referencing.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view providing users with relevant document lists, acknowledgement statuses, and evaluation reports.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search function providing filtered result lists based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The kind of report (e.g. Status Report: Documents & Instruction, Document Monitoring, Status Report for Acknowledgement).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have read and taken note of a released document version, tracked and documented in the system.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group that retains read access to archived and invalidated documents after all other authorizations have been revoked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document object in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: An author or co-author edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: maintain_document_metadata
evts.description: An author or co-author maintains or updates the standardized and customer-specific metadata attributes in the document properties.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts a saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: An author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness within the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The system creates a new editing version of a released document when revisions, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals occur.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An author adds a controlled attachment document to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An author modifies the content of an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An author adds supplementary information to a document that is not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author deletes additional information directly from a document due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing document without affecting the document's current content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of editing an assigned change proposal, notifying the creator.

evts.name: generate_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser or the author/reviewer/releaser team confirms additional validity of the document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the archiving process.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A releaser or the review/release team declares a document out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes a document after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends acknowledgement requests by email to users and user groups on the distribution list upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms that they have read and taken note of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: The technical administration assigns a user to a system user group, making them available in selection lists.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned to a document via its properties.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: view_document_on_dashboard
evts.description: A reader views relevant documents listed on their role-specific dashboard.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates an evaluation report with selected parameters and criteria to filter document result lists.

o2o.description: A document can reference other documents via the References attribute.
A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are released together with the main document.
A document can have one or more supplementary additional information objects attached to it.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is managed within the document's cockpit.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate invalidation and archiving.
A request for reactivation selects a specific previously invalidated document for reactivation.
Each document has a distribution list maintained in its cockpit specifying user groups and persons for distribution.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new documents.
Documents can be linked to and filed under business processes.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risk objects within the system.
Documents can be linked to master data objects such as IT applications for cross-referencing.
In a multi-client system, a document's visibility can be specified per client.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups for email notification or acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list can contain directly assigned individual persons.
Users are assigned to user groups by the technical administration.
Users in the archive group retain read access to archived and invalidated documents.
